{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Chunky roll-neck sweater, relaxed fit, hip length, cream #f3e9d8, soft merino wool
Straight-leg jeans, full ankle length, deep indigo #1f2a44, heavy cotton denim
Double-breasted coat, midi length just below the knee, with a wide collar, emerald #0f7a54, dense brushed wool blend
Lug-sole ankle boots, waterproof and easy to wipe clean of salt, black #1a1a1a, treated leather with a warm lining
Oversized scarf, long and wrapped twice at the neck, mustard #d9a21b, thick wool
Beanie, slightly slouchy, cream #f3e9d8, ribbed wool knit
Lined gloves, black #1a1a1a, soft leather with a fleece lining
Small crossbody bag, cognac #9a5a2e, smooth leather

This outfit stands out through colour rather than fussy details: the emerald coat echoes your green eyes and makes your copper hair glow, while the mustard scarf adds a second bold note. The cream knit and deep indigo denim keep the look clean and let the colour pieces take centre stage. For snow at -3 °C and salted pavements, the coat is warm and long, the boots grip and wipe clean, and the full-length jeans are sturdy. The sweater and coat are easy to take off, so you will be comfortable in the warmth of the cafés and still turn heads walking through the centre."}
